notes.semetey-1-2013:p0219:b003:l015: Repeated Eshen condemnation and commands retained, not compressed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0219:b003:l017: Because I am a woman explicit complaint against gendered scorn, not omitted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0219:b003:l020: Dogs for даңгыт; threat to slaughter and drink blood is character’s conditional oath, not narrator event, no added gore/procedure beyond source.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0219:b003:l028: Taboo oath to marry own father Temir Khan explicitly printed; preserved as self-curse, not actual marriage or sexual act narrated. Adjacent hair wording27 remains unresolved separately.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0219:b003:l035: Primary Yudakhin мурдала exact муну угуп эшен чал, мурдалап коркуп жан чыгып = old ishan already scared to death. Fear metaphor not actual death. Eshen transliterated title here; primary identifies religious ishan, prior proper-name interpretation tentative.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0219:b003:l038: Primary Yudakhin сап exact билегинен сап кеткен, жүрөгүнөн кап кеткен: weapon haft drops, heart casing bursts from fear. No named weapon or literal medical death asserted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0219:b005:l004: Primary Yudakhin биринде divide/separate, beard parts strand by strand; corrected initial unsupported trembling during lexical review.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0219:b005:l005: God’s sun clouded, sixty worries simultaneously, source fear images retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0219:b005:l011: Жалаңкыч devouring demon appearance, not factual supernatural identity.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0219:b005:l014: Internal thought with repeated деп retained, personal fear not independent assertion Kanykei has killed them.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0219:b005:l023: Indented24 continuation one verse; соогат beg captive’s life as a gift/pardon, not request material reward for attack. Repeated28+29 preserved.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0219:b005:l031: Bitch insult and troublemaking designation belong character’s thought. Жоболоң commotion primary exact, no invented name.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0219:b005:l034: Эр warrior descriptor of woman, not male gender change; next36 repeats warrior build.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0219:b005:l037: Уз beauty among women, not craftsperson forced into context. Girlhood recall leads220.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0220:b003:l001: Hair about head and about feet3 both retained, no deduplication or actual entanglement incident asserted.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0220:b003:l008: Renown raising dust and hearth ember metaphor of formidable child literal, no new house fire.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0220:b003:l013: Not yet14 explicit age in retrospective, retained even though earlier memories give12; no harmonization. Wedding refusal remains non-graphic source narrative.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0220:b003:l024: Ат кара тил established primary seasonal expression early summer when horses’ tongues darken; literal seasonal formula retained, not diseased horse advice.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0220:b003:l026: 7000 barren beasts source no explicit species noun, no invented mares where livestock category uncertain.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0220:b003:l028: Father-in-law Temir Khan receives bride-price; source father of Kanykei not Manas’s biological father.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0220:b003:l034: Өлө турган ой fatal plan literal difficult phrase; source ominous wedding context, no new motive or later death invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0220:b003:l037: Күндүзү сексен той = eighty feasts by day, not automatically eighty days of feasting from other witness.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0220:b003:l039: Каада ceremonial honors/custom; чийилип primary inscribed. Literal ceremony/honors inscribed upon iron-gated Bukhara door retained provisionally across column, exact image obscure; no silent substitution army lining up or battle plan.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0220:b004:l009: Аркак weft in curtain, not warp or geometric silk pattern invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0220:b004:l011: Primary Yudakhin бутта exact буттаган алтын кызыл зер / жеңгетайга алганда = receiving gold by the pood for bridal attendants’ services. Not gold legs or generic gold by weight with unit lost. Pood traditional unit retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0220:b004:l013: 70 young wives and90 girls distinct attendants, no age assumptions about all girls added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0220:b004:l016: Primary Yudakhin жазайыл figurative misfortune, exact marriage-refusal formula жазайыл салып мойнума ... жатпай кетти койнума. Not literal gun hung around neck. Agent/referent neck provisional Manas.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0220:b004:l018: Bride refuses to lie in his arms; implicit intimacy only as printed, no explicit sexual detail added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0220:b004:l022: Dagger forearm injury literal, no added wound detail. Manas’s complaint25 repeats and is kept.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0220:b004:l028: Six raids of Bukhara source claim retained even if other recaps differ; not independently historical assertion.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0220:b004:l030: Narrator/character blames woman using arrogant/luckless epithets, historical voice retained without endorsement.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0220:b004:l033: Primary Yudakhin такай II donkey foal, not heel/tax. Redundant offspring/foal across two verses kept; impoverishment deprived even of foal, not new killing of donkey infant narrated.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0220:b004:l039: Primary бадырек=бадирек wretch/rogue, not proper name.
